rationale: Prior slices support combining complementary sidecars behind daily-archive-owned contracts: GROBID for scholarly TEI/bibliography/citations, OpenDataLoader for layout/OCR/table/coordinate candidates, Adaptix for typed adapter mapping, and quant-mind for architecture patterns only.

component_responsibilities.adapter_boundary: TEI-to-daily-archive candidate adapter with source/ref anchors and bibliography/citation review gates
fixed JSON/Markdown/HTML/Text outputs become candidate sidecar artifacts only

owns: structural mapping from fixed OpenDataLoader JSON into typed candidate summaries
component_responsibilities.adapter_boundary: post-processing layer after parser output, before daily-archive validators/review packets
ideas reimplemented under daily-archive-owned schemas, never imported as runtime dependency in this track

must_not_own: blind trust in parser sidecar output
positive import eligibility from parser success alone
component_responsibilities.adapter_boundary: all parser sidecars terminate in candidate artifacts until validators and independent review complete

recommended_flow: source acquisition proves local PDF/source path, hash, size, and catalog identity
GROBID produces scholarly TEI sidecar candidates
OpenDataLoader-style backend produces layout/OCR/table/page-coordinate sidecar candidates
Adaptix maps fixed OpenDataLoader JSON into typed daily-archive candidate summaries
quant-mind-inspired schemas guide PageIndex/tree/card/provenance design under daily-archive ownership
daily-archive validators normalize diagnostics and reject low-quality/unsafe/stale/source-span failures
completed review packet may be prepared for graph-readiness review; parser output alone is never import eligibility

rejected_alternatives.reason: GROBID is strong for scholarly TEI/bibliography/citations but does not prove table fidelity, OCR replacement, or layout-coordinate completeness.
OpenDataLoader provides layout/OCR/table/page candidates but not scholarly bibliography authority or graph-ready semantic contracts.
Adaptix validates structure and mapping shape; it cannot validate reading order, table fidelity, source spans, or factual correctness.
quant-mind requires OpenAI/API/network-coupled flows for its live pipeline and has placeholder/missing GraphKnowledge/storage/retrieval/RAG layers.
M033 is research only; graph-readiness review and no-write import rehearsal remain independent blockers.

required_before_implementation: future bounded quality plan from S06
